Mainly though, your demo feedback has helped make the start of the game even smoother and removed any friction you might have felt if you played the demo early on.[\/p][p][b]Controls[\/b] have been improved, Maeve's movement speed is [b]faster[\/b], she can [b]jump[\/b] [b]higher[\/b], Roland's gravity tethers are [b]faster and have longer range[\/b], and there are many more improvements.[\/p][p][b]I'll keep balancing and tweaking as well as fixing any bugs that appear![\/b] Keep the feedback coming![\/p][p][\/p][h3][b]Q: Why are you releasing straight to 1.0 and not doing Early Access?[\/b][\/h3][p]A: This is a great question! The [b]biggest[\/b] reason is that because the [b]story and narrative are so core[\/b] [b]to the game[\/b], [i]it just wouldn't be a good experience[\/i]. No-one wants to start playing, get really into the story and gameplay, and then suddenly you just... can't play any more? [b]That won't happen here![\/b][\/p][p]Plus... we're all [i]just a little bored [\/i]of Early Access now, right? I wanted to do something different and provide a complete experience with a proper beginning, middle, and end. [b]A full and wholesome adventure that you can devour at your own pace, with no artificial blockers or 'this bit isn't done yet'.[\/b][\/p][p]Now, all of this [b]doesn't mean[\/b] there is zero chance of bugs occurring, that tweaks to balancing won't happen, or that I won't even add more new content! [b]It just means the game is a full, rounded and complete experience.[\/b][\/p][p][\/p][h3][b]Q: Is there Gamepad\/Controller support? [b]It's a top priority[\/b] after launch, and I ask that if you want to play the game this way, you [b]Follow and Wishlist on Steam[\/b] and you'll see the news in future when support is added for a good, solid experience![\/p][p][b]Steam Deck Support [\/b]is officially signed off as 'Playable' by Valve, but I will also be working to make the experience better post-launch and aim to achieve Verified.[\/p][p][\/p][h3][b]Q: What are your post-launch plans?[\/b][\/h3][p]A: Honestly, that depends how things go! Why not?![\/p][p]I've pushed a full patch and a ton of hotfixes for the demo in the last couple of days, so if you tried it and had any issues, now's a good chance to give it a second shot![\/p][p][b]Your progress will carry over seamlessly to the full game[\/b], so get started on your adventure and pick up where you left off at launch on March 6th![\/p][p][img src=\"{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}\/44678379\/f398b3b30da81d535f9e44ed5cdfa9956ce5c0d7.gif\"][\/img][\/p][h3]If you enjoyed your time with the demo, [b]the biggest thing you can do to help ahead of launch is to leave a positive review! \ud83d\udc96 Thank you![\/b][\/h3][p][\/p][h1]Launch Pricing[\/h1][p][i]AETHUS[\/i] will be available on Steam at a special discounted launch price of[b] $15.99 \/ \u00a313.20 \/ \u20ac15.99![\/b][\/p][p][i]In addition, if you're already the owner of one of the games mentioned in the [b]Bundles [\/b]section further down, you'll get an additional [b]10% discount on the game![\/b][\/i][\/p][p][u]After two weeks[\/u], the discount will end and the game will be available at the regular price of [b]$19.99 \/ \u00a316.50 \/ \u20ac19.99.[\/b][\/p][p][b][i]AETHUS[\/i] is a fully complete, v1.0 game with no Early Access[\/b], so you're getting a [b]finished experience[\/b] with [b]30+ hours of content[\/b] all in one go, with no microtransactions or other nonsense.[\/p][p][i]I hope you feel that this price is good value for money, especially in these tough economic times.[\/i][\/p][p][\/p][p][dynamiclink href=\"https:\/\/store.steampowered.com\/app\/2541530\/AETHUS\/\"][\/dynamiclink][\/p][p][b]Note - I have adjusted prices in certain regions to make sure that they're fairer than Steam's default values[\/b] as I am aware that there's often a disparity in affordability in these regions and I want to make sure the game is affordable for all. If you notice the price in your region seems excessive, please get in touch and I can look into it![\/p][p][i]Final Tip - There won't be a discount beyond 20% for the first year of release so if you're keen, you may as well get stuck in at launch![\/i][\/p][p][\/p][h1]Launch Time[\/h1][p]The game will launch worldwide on [b]March 6th at 4PM GMT[\/b] [b]\/ 5PM UTC \/ 8AM PST \/ 11AM EST.[\/b][\/p][p][url=\"https:\/\/www.timeanddate.com\/worldclock\/fixedtime.html?msg=AETHUS+Launch&iso=20260306T16&p1=304\"][b]Click here to see the time of launch in your own local time![\/b][\/url][\/p][p][\/p][h1]Game Editions[\/h1][p]The game will be available both in its standard form or in the form of a [b]Supporter's Edition[\/b] which comes with two extras [b](that can also be purchased separately!)[\/b][\/p][p]The [b]Supporter's Edition[\/b] will also give you an [b]extra 10% off[\/b] the total price of these extras together compared to purchasing separately. They are...[\/p][h1]Optional Extras[\/h1][h3][u]Supporter's Pack[\/u][\/h3][p]If you'd like to further support me to be able to create more games after [i]AETHUS[\/i] or feel that you've received more value than expected, you might like to purchase the [b]Supporter's Pack[\/b], available for [b]$4.99[\/b] or local equivalent.[\/p][p][dynamiclink href=\"https:\/\/store.steampowered.com\/app\/4235910\/AETHUS__Supporters_Pack\"][\/dynamiclink][img src=\"{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}\/44678379\/e657476e338082384cbdaf9f2e878a8db05de965.png\"][\/img][\/p][p]The pack provides a new [b]Gold Visual Customization [\/b]for Maeve and Roland in-game, as well as a [b]Gold Outpost Theme[\/b] to use to decorate your habitats and facilities. [b]There is no gameplay benefit[\/b] to anything in the Supporter's Pack, it's merely a way to chuck a few extra quid my way if you want to, and it's [i]very much appreciated.[\/i][\/p][p][\/p][h3][u]Original Soundtrack[\/u][\/h3][p][i]AETHUS[\/i] features [b]17 original music tracks, [\/b]composed by the very talented [b]Madison James Smith.[\/b][\/p][p][dynamiclink href=\"https:\/\/store.steampowered.com\/app\/4235920\/AETHUS_Soundtrack\"][\/dynamiclink][img src=\"{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}\/44678379\/09d92712cd93b9e00d1698b969ac9dd35897391e.jpg\"][\/img][\/p][p]If you'd like to support the game further and get a copy of the soundtrack for yourself in the process, you can purchase this pack for [b]$4.99[\/b] or local equivalent.[\/p][p][b]50% of the profit from sales of the Soundtrack goes directly to the composer, Madison, as a thank you for his amazing work on the game![\/b][\/p][p][\/p][h1]Bundles[\/h1][p]I am partnering with three awesome games to give you the option of even more survival adventures by purchasing both them and [i]AETHUS[\/i] at the same time, at a discount![\/p][p][b]As a bonus, if you already own one of these games, the bundle will simply get you an extra 10% off [i]AETHUS[\/i], on top of the launch discount![\/b][\/p][p]Big thanks to the developers of these great games for supporting the launch of the game.[\/p][h3]Forever Skies[\/h3][p][dynamiclink href=\"https:\/\/store.steampowered.com\/app\/1641960\/Forever_Skies\/\"][\/dynamiclink][\/p][h3]Eden Crafters[\/h3][p][dynamiclink href=\"https:\/\/store.steampowered.com\/app\/2570210\/Eden_Crafters\/\"][\/dynamiclink][\/p][h3]Astrometica[\/h3][p][dynamiclink href=\"https:\/\/store.steampowered.com\/app\/2353250\/Astrometica\/\"][\/dynamiclink][\/p][h1]Frequently Asked Questions[\/h1][h3][b]Q: Why are you releasing straight to 1.0 and not doing Early Access?[\/b][\/h3][p]A: This is a great question! The [b]biggest[\/b] reason is that because the [b]story and narrative are so core[\/b] [b]to the game[\/b], [i]it just wouldn't be a good experience[\/i]. No-one wants to start playing, get really into the story and gameplay, and then suddenly you just... can't play any more? [b]That won't happen here![\/b][\/p][p]Plus... we're all [i]just a little bored [\/i]of Early Access now, right? [b]A full and wholesome adventure that you can devour at your own pace, with no artificial blockers or 'this bit isn't done yet'.[\/b][\/p][p]Now, all of this [b]doesn't mean[\/b] there is zero chance of bugs occurring, that tweaks to balancing won't happen, or that I won't even add more new content! [b]It just means the game is a full, rounded and complete experience.[\/b][\/p][p][b]Some people have said that I'm making a commercial mistake[\/b] doing a full 1.0 launch and I should have just done Early Access like everyone else, but it's genuinely more important to me that you get to play the whole game at once and [b]experience Maeve and Roland's story as I truly intended.[\/b][\/p][p][\/p][h3][b]Q: Does that mean the game is going to be full of bugs?[\/b][\/h3][p]A: I sure hope not! [b]Seriously though[\/b], the game has been played through [i]a lot[\/i] by a whole bunch of amazing playtesters (and by me!) who have helped shape and form it into what I feel is [b]a really nice, polished experience.[\/b] [\/p][p]Of course there's always the chance for some rough edges (show me a game that launches [i]entirely bug free![\/i]) but [b]I'll be working as quickly as I can to fix up anything that needs it after launch.[\/b][\/p][p][\/p][h3][b]Q: Is there Gamepad\/Controller support?[\/b][\/h3][p]A: As the game is very mouse-heavy, I wanted to do a proper custom interaction scheme for gamepad that [b]isn't just a half-assed 'support'[\/b] that's a worse experience than playing with M+KB.[\/p][p][b]Unfortunately, there just wasn't time[\/b] before release to do it proper justice. Launch Questions Answered![/h1][p][/p][p]We've gotten some great questions that we'd like to answer here, a little FAQ if you'll indulge us:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Is the game playable on Steam Deck?[/b][/p][p]Yes! Many of our playtesters play the game on Steam Deck with touch controls. It also plays great on touch devices through Steam Link, so you can play on your phone or tablet!

We are still working on Steam Deck verification, thanks for your patience.

[b]Is there controller support?
[/b]Not yet! We love playing deckbuilders with controllers, so this is on the roadmap. However, with so many menus we wanted to make sure we took the time to make it the smoothest and best experience possible. We will keep you updated on this!

[b]Is the game appropriate for all ages?[/b][/p][p]Depends, but we have had playtesters as young as six playing the game (with some reading assistance from an adult!) There is no gore, only cartoon violence, and minimal references to drugs and alcohol from our teenage characters. Younger players might ask you what a slap bracelet is, though.

[b]I found a bug!
[/b]Oh no! Please tell us about any bugs or feature requests using this form: [url="https://forms.gle/5PwwiRp79oNqrkW47"]https://forms.gle/5PwwiRp79oNqrkW47[/url][/p][h1]
Trivia Time![/h1][p]Did you enjoy last week's trivia? and this first major patch brings several of the most requested changes, along with multiple fixes and a balance pass.[/p][p][/p][h1]Patch Notes[/h1][p][/p][h3][b]Optional Mini-Games[/b][/h3][p]Available in [b]Settings → Game[/b], you can now disable harvesting mini-games if you prefer a more streamlined experience or feel they become repetitive in the mid to late game. Mini-games can be enabled or disabled at any time.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]New Controls Page[/b][/h3][p]Accessible through the [b]pause menu[/b], this page shows an image explaining your character’s control layout. Controls for UI interactions are not included here, as those are already displayed when interacting with each interface.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]New Help Page[/b][/h3][p]Also accessible through the [b]pause menu[/b], this option was previously hidden behind the [b]H key[/b]. It is now easier to access and provides more detailed explanations for many of the mechanics you’ll use throughout the game.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]New Spiritual Elixirs (Faith)[/b][/h3][p]New elixirs that restore [b]Faith[/b] can now be crafted in the [b]Laboratory[/b]. This is one of the first changes to the Faith system, with more improvements coming soon.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Item Durability Increased[/b][/h3][p]Durability has been increased for several pieces of equipment. We’ve seen the frustration around low durability and will continue monitoring this change while keeping the [b]Repair Kit[/b] mechanic relevant.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Repair Kit moved to Workshop Level 1[/b][/h3][p]We noticed that some players were unaware of the repair mechanic. The [b]Repair Kit[/b] recipe has been moved to [b]Workshop Level 1[/b] so it becomes available earlier. A new tutorial explaining how repair kits work has also been added.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Cinderwolf Loot Fix[/b][/h3][p]Cinderwolves were not dropping the correct loot, making some items impossible to obtain. This issue has now been fixed.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Longer Day Cycle[/b][/h3][p]The length of the day has been increased to give players more time to explore the forest.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]New Game Save Bug Fixed[/b][/h3][p]Starting a new game previously deleted existing save files. This was a major oversight on our part, and we sincerely apologize to those affected. This issue has now been fixed.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Aberration Drop Rate Increased[/b][/h3][p]The chance of obtaining [b]Aberrations[/b] has been increased based on player feedback. Processing aberrations now also yields slightly more loot.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Bandit Loot Improved[/b][/h3][p]Bandits now drop more valuable loot, making encounters with them more rewarding.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Improved Player Roll[/b][/h3][p]Rolling should now feel faster and more precise, and you can now attack or draw your weapon sooner after rolling.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Movement and Stuck Fixes[/b][/h3][p]We’ve made adjustments to reduce the chances of getting stuck on assets or uneven terrain.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]That’s all for now! We’re continuing to work on further improvements, including:[/p][list][*][p]Additional [b]Faith system improvements[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Survival difficulty settings[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Controller support[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Keybinding[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you all for your patience and for helping us improve the game.[/p][p]See you in the forest.

(3/7/2026)","posttime":1772912318,"updatetime":1772912318,"body":"[p][/p][p]Greetings nubheads and nublings old and new,[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Today is Nubbyday... aka Nubby's first birthday! What a year! That kind of snuck up on me to be honest. I'd like to start by saying that it's probably been the most fun and significant year of my life in terms of career success. Heck, I was a junior in college one year ago and I didn't even have a career. Today I have the privilege of calling myself a full time indie developer. Of course, this is all thanks to nubby and everyone who has supported me as a game developer throughout this past year! I'm grateful for all of the memories made, friends met, lessons learned over the past year. It's my honor to bring you nubby and I wouldn't change a single thing if I could go back in time and do it again. Thank you for 1 really awesome year of nubby![/p][p][/p][p]In this announcement I will be revealing a couple upcoming fun things that myself and a few friends have put together for the real nubheads out there. Before that, I'll start with a brief word about the v1.4.4 patch that released for nubby yesterday.[/p][p][/p][p]Enjoy![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Patch V1.4.4 (released 3/6/2026):[/p][p]==========[/p][p]Yesterday I released patch v1.4.4, which primarily added support in NNF for the Danish language! If you've got a Danish friend, let them know that nubby has landed in Denmark! I'm very pleased with the efforts of community member Rapandrasmus for the amazing work on the Danish localization! [/p][p][/p][p]Efforts for many more localizations are underway and those will hopefully be added to the game in the coming weeks/months. Thank you to all of the community members who have offered to volunteer, regardless of whether I could accept your offer. There's a lot of really cool people who play this game and simply want to help make it more accessible. It blows me away![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Nubbyday Reveal #1: Nubby Stickers and Keychains Are Coming!:[/p][p]==========[/p][p]In honor of Nubbyday, you'll soon be able to wear nubby on your backpack and stick nubby related things on your wall! [/p][p][/p][p]You heard that right! I wasn't too interested in apparel merchandise like shirts or sweaters, but I figured that stickers and keychains would be a good fit for the type of people who are big fans of nubby. It's subtle, but ones of those if you know you know type of things. This merch drop is just a small thing that I, and a few other nubby lovers in the merch biz have put together.[/p][p][/p][p]If you're interested in picking up a keychain, some stickers, or both - they unfortunately won't be out for a couple months yet because they're being manufactured right now and will then need to ship. Rest assured, when they're available I will be loud about it here and on the community discord server so you can get one before they run out. Now for the fun part.. pictures![/p][p][/p][p]Firstly, the animation below shows what all 6 sticker varieties will look like. I personally made all of the art for these stickers in blender over the past few months. I hope you enjoy these designs because I had a great time making them :][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300425/1834e084e5e9e4dfa9a794449eaeba3c6d0e8d65.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Next up nubby keychains! Today we are doing a small but necessary hotfix from our side for the current Experimental, there’s no new major fixes or additions, but this will help with our current way of parsing crash reports so we can better address more crashes in the future


If you haven’t yet but are interested in giving the Experimental version a try remember to [b]BACKUP YOUR SAVE[/b] before trying it to avoid losing any of your progress

[b]You can backup your save by copying the folders in:[/b][/p][quote][p]C:Users\\\[YOUR USER]AppDataLocalFactoryGameSavedSaveGames\\\[YOUR ID FOLDERS][/p][/quote][p][b]To access the Experimental version on Steam:[/b]

Right click Satisfactory on your library > Properties > Game Versions & Betas > experimental

Then exit this menu and the experimental version will start downloading for you

[b]To access the Experimental version on Epic:[/b]

In your Library, search for “Satisfactory Experimental” and install it, it’s a separate entry from the default version so you need to download it individually

If you run into any new issues when trying the latest Experimental, please let us know over at our QA Site [url="https://questions.satisfactorygame.com/"]https://questions.satisfactorygame.com/[/url] Your posts are extremely valuable for us and we read them every day

Thank you for your support and feedback during this Experimental, See you next time <3

[b]HOTFIX[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed internal issue with our crash reporter receiving significant log spam in some scenarios
[/list]
I’m also attaching below the patch notes from the previous patch below for quick reference

[b]NEW[/b]
[list]
[*] Upgraded Unreal Engine version to 5.6.1
[*] Bringing the PC version to parity with the Console version, Including:
[list]
[*] Quality of life improvements and changes done to Controller support
[*] Hundreds of bugfixes and polish across all elements in the game
[*] Localization Updates to all official languages
[/list]

Tweaks:
-Localization has been improved dramatically once more, with more glaring and obvious typos corrected.
-To that end, all buildables have had localization added or improved.
-A lot of the art in the game has been improved. Check out Lucky Gorblash for a comparison!
-Buildable Bar fridge save/load is corrected.
-When building, it is now more obvious when a placement is invalid.
-Performance continues to be improved - this is especially noticable with regards to large cargo rooms & movey/stockbot armies.
-Added planet punch.
-Added new placeable speakeasy fridge.
-Avoidance has been added to certain furniture items. 
-Total money earned for that day is now displayed on the end of day UI.
-Airlock item effects are improved.
-Fill speed of watering gun on standard sink has been increased.
-Employee speed is now increased dramatically..
-Customers no longer get 'Stuck' at night time trying to go to the diner.

Additions: 
-Furbles now has a cat bed, cat tree, and water bowl. He's also got some newer behaviors.
-Cargo Containers now show if the item is available for use in the speakeasy (If the speakeasy is unlocked.)
-Trashcans have been added as buildable items. Customers will toss their garbage in a trash bin if one is nearby, rather than on the floor.
-The checkout counter can now be moved around the station, and is no longer fixed in place.
-Customers now react when they are sprayed with water.-Teleporter Room can now be upgraded two times, increasing teleporter count from 3 to 6 to 8
-Hydroponics can now be upgraded two times as well, increasing space, adding the packager, and eventually additional landing bays.
-'Packager' added to Hydroponics, allowing you to quickly bag fruits.
 
 Bug Fixes:
 -Fixed movie picking up storage from the speakeasy. 
-Fixed plant growth when fertilizer was applied not taking into account the last state 
-Putting crate in an empty speakeasy shelf no longer breaks it
-Customers now put dirty drinks back on their trays. 
-Dirty (and clean) cups can now be moved to the sink while holding a tray.
-Hoop Streak can no longer be ended by the airlock. 

What's next? 
We're working improving controller support across the game.
Content additions as always.

Thank you guys for playing Space Corp! If you are enjoying the game, please leave a review. It helps now more than ever ! If not, come pop into Discord and tell Space Corp what's what!

<3

of Everything — Update 0.2.5 Roadmap + 0.2.4a Patch Coming Soon!","posttime":1773184649,"updatetime":1773185145,"body":"[hr][/hr][h1]🧭 End of Everything — Update 0.2.5 Roadmap[/h1][p][/p][p]Development for [b]Update 0.2.5[/b] is currently underway and will introduce major improvements to survival systems, world interaction, the new player experience, and overall gameplay balance.[/p][p][/p][p]Many of these changes come directly from [b]community feedback[/b], and development will continue evolving as new systems and improvements are added to the game.[/p][p][/p][p]Some systems will arrive earlier through smaller updates leading up to the full [b]0.2.5 release[/b].[/p][hr][/hr][h1]🔧 Update 0.2.4a — Survival Systems Patch [i](Releasing Soon)[/i][/h1][p][/p][p]Update [b]0.2.4a[/b] will introduce several improvements to survival mechanics, crafting clarity, and early gameplay systems while development continues toward the full [b]0.2.5 update[/b].[/p][hr][/hr][h2]🦠 Sickness System[/h2][p]A new [b]sickness system[/b] will be introduced.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45178465/67d0cef189bee82203d70b0522ca4930802c27a9.png"][/img]Instead of taking direct damage from unsafe items, players may now become [b]sick[/b] when consuming contaminated resources.
[/p][p]Possible causes include:[/p][p]• Drinking [b]dirty water[/b]
• Eating [b]rotten meat[/b][/p][p][/p][p]When sick, players may experience effects such as:[/p][p]• [b]Health reduction over time[/b]
• [b]Brief stamina drops[/b] (stamina can temporarily drop to 0)
• A [b]green sickness screen overlay[/b]
• [b]Coughing sounds[/b] that increase as sickness worsens[/p][p][/p][p]If left untreated, sickness can reduce the player's [b]overall health significantly below the normal 100 HP limit[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]Players will need [b]antibiotics[/b] to cure sickness.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45178465/2e6fb8c7cf3994c4828539909840886d09dbfe78.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h2]💧 Dirty Water Improvements[/h2][p]Dirty water now works with the sickness system.[/p][p][/p][p]Players can drink dirty water from environmental sources including:[/p][p]• Toilets
• Sinks
• Bathtubs
• Showers[/p][p][/p][p]Dirty water restores thirst but carries a [b]risk of sickness[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]Dirty water sources [b]respawn after approximately 6 hours of in-game time.[/b][/p][hr][/hr][h2]🥩 Rotten Food System[/h2][p]Rotten meat will now properly interact with the sickness system.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45178465/ad3da86bf0d362b3801951cb71d523bbeb3003df.png"][/img][/p][p]Eating spoiled meat will risk [b]causing sickness instead of immediate damage[/b].[/p][hr][/hr][h2]🔪 New Early Weapons[/h2][p]Several early survival weapons will be introduced:[/p][p][/p][p]• [b]Bone Knife
[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45178465/1d4e56f8344e8df97c2c2b84f49f4fbbe027c151.png"][/img]
• [b]Wooden Club
[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45178465/3f73551f1dc2c7d5687bbe5a6806cfda747bc934.png"][/img]
• [b]Spiked Wooden Club[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45178465/35d4739ff3ad06398f0dd97b2f394fc38c5cdf9d.png"][/img][/p][p]These give players more options during early survival encounters.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]🧰 Crafting UI Improvements[/h2][p]Several improvements are being made to improve [b]crafting interface readability[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]Improvements include:[/p][p]• Better crafting UI visibility
• Clearer crafting material requirements
• Improved crafting menu readability[/p][hr][/hr][h2]💰 Old World Money (Phase 1)[/h2][p]The [b]Old World Money[/b] currency will begin appearing across the world.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45178465/ef9c72a39749eb8d4c3e80522596116ac991c61d.png"][/img][/p][p]Players will begin finding currency items scattered throughout buildings and containers.

Sources: Cash registers, Safes, ATMs, Corpses, Vehicles.
[/p][p]This currency will later be used with [b]traders[/b], which are planned to be introduced in updates leading into [b]0.2.5[/b].[/p][hr][/hr][h2]🎓 Tutorial Level [i](Introduced in 0.2.4a)[/i][/h2][p]A [b]basic tutorial level[/b] will be introduced to help new players learn the core mechanics of the game before entering the main world.[/p][p][/p][p]The tutorial will cover:[/p][p]• Movement and exploration
• Searching containers and looting
• Drinking water from environmental sources
• Inventory management
• Crafting basic tools
• Basic survival mechanics[/p][p]The tutorial system will [b]expand and improve over time[/b] as development continues.[/p][p][/p][p]To prevent exploitation, [b]Steam achievements and player stats will be disabled while inside the tutorial level.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Players will also have the option to [b]skip the tutorial[/b] and begin directly in the open world.[/p][hr][/hr][h1]🚀 Update 0.2.5 — Major Survival Expansion[/h1][p][/p][p]Update [b]0.2.5[/b] will introduce several major gameplay systems and improvements to the survival experience.[/p][hr][/hr][h1]🧠 New Player Experience Improvements[/h1][p]Improving the [b]early gameplay experience[/b] is a major focus of this update.[/p][p][/p][p]A new [b]tips and hints system[/b] will appear during gameplay to guide players through survival mechanics such as:[/p][p]• Looting containers
• Crafting items
• Finding water sources
• Basic survival strategies[/p][hr][/hr][h2]📦 Item Description Improvements[/h2][p]All items will receive [b]clearer descriptions[/b] explaining their purpose and uses.[/p][p][/p][p]This will help players better understand:[/p][p]• crafting materials

We're excited to bring you a massive content update featuring [b]25 brand new Zodiac Boons[/b] that will dramatically expand your strategic options! [/p][hr][/hr][h2]✨ New Boons by Zodiac Sign[/h2][h3]♈ Aries (Fire)[/h3][list][*][p][b]Ram's Arsenal:[/b] At the start of combat, gain 3 Strength per Rare Attack card in your Deck Pile.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Warrior's Trophy:[/b] After every 4th combat, add a Rare Attack card to your deck.
[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]♋ Cancer (Water)[/h3][list][*][p][b]Buffed Claws:[/b] Deal 3 more damage for every positive combat effect you have (max 3).
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tidal Cleansing:[/b] At the end of combat, recover 4 HP per Curse card, up to 20 HP.
[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]♑ Capricorn (Earth)[/h3][list][*][p][b]Goat's Climb:[/b] After every 2nd Earth boon triggered, upgrade one random Skill card in hand for this combat.
[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]♊ Gemini (Air)[/h3][list][*][p][b]Dual Wisdom:[/b] After every 4th combat, add a Rare Skill card to your deck.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Reflected Power:[/b] 75% chance to gain positive combat effects twice.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Wind Weaver:[/b] Air boons trigger twice with 30% chance.
[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]♌ Leo (Fire)[/h3][list][*][p][b]Regal Presence:[/b] After every 2nd Power played, apply -3 Strength to all enemies.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Royal Decree:[/b] Gain 1 Strength whenever you play a Power card.
[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]♎ Libra (Air)[/h3][list][*][p][b]Balanced Authority:[/b] After every 4th combat, add a Rare Power card to your deck.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Trinity Balance:[/b] Draw 3 cards if all card types are played in a single turn.
[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]♓ Pisces (Water)[/h3][list][*][p][b]Deep Sea Pressure:[/b] Deal 6 additional damage to enemies with Weak.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dreamweaver's Touch:[/b] When you apply Weak to an enemy, apply 3 Defenceless to a random enemy.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Illusory Depths:[/b] Apply 2 Weak to all enemies whenever a Water boon triggers.
[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]♐ Sagittarius (Fire)[/h3][list][*][p][b]Blaze Chain:[/b] Discover a Fire card and add to your Draw Pile whenever a Fire boon triggers.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Trailblazer's Mark:[/b] When cards are dealt, exhaust up to 2 cards and gain 1 Mana per card.
[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]♏ Scorpio (Water)[/h3][list][*][p][b]Corrupted Power:[/b] At the start of combat, gain 3 Strength for each Curse card in your Deck Pile.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Cursed Retribution:[/b] Deal 7 damage to all enemies whenever you draw a Curse card.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Venomous Flow:[/b] Apply 5 Poison to a random enemy whenever a Water boon triggers.
[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]♉ Taurus (Earth)[/h3][list][*][p][b]Golden Collection:[/b] Receive 12 Moondust whenever an Earth boon triggers.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Steadfast Value:[/b] Receive 3 Moondust whenever you play a card with cost 2 or more.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Terra Resonance:[/b] Discover an Earth card and add to your Draw Pile whenever an Earth boon triggers.
[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]♍ Virgo (Earth)[/h3][list][*][p][b]Analytical Move:[/b] If you played exactly 5 cards, draw 2 cards and gain 1 Mana next turn.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Orderly Retreat:[/b] Gain 5x of unspent Mana as Block next turn.
[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][h2]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p][b]Fixed:[/b] Testo Explosion bug has been resolved.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved:[/b] Card play sequence mechanics for smoother gameplay.
 [/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][h2]💭 What's Next?[/h2][p]We're continuously working on balancing these new boons and gathering your feedback. Let us know what you think about the new additions!

[p]
Update [b]0.6.5[/b] is now available!

This is an intermediate step before the next major update, which will finally introduce the highly anticipated [b]rooftop[/b] with its cocktail preparation system.

Good news: the game is now on promotion with a [b]-20%[/b] discount. This is the perfect time to take advantage, especially since the multiplayer mode has just been expanded.

This update brings several major changes regarding progression, employee management, and multiplayer.
[/p]

[h2]🤝 Coop Extended to 8 Players[/h2]
[p]
During this development phase, we tested up to [b]10 players[/b] in cooperative mode. Results were very positive with smooth gameplay and stable FPS between [b]120 and 140 FPS[/b] in a full restaurant. To prepare for the arrival of new floors and the rooftop, cooperative mode is now officially extended to [b]8 players[/b]. You can now invite up to [b]7 friends[/b] to your game.
[/p]

[h2]📈 Complete Overhaul of the Progression System[/h2]
[p]
The progression system has been fully redesigned to be more readable and to let you better control the path you want to follow. Previously, missions were listed vertically and were the main key for progression via satisfaction and money to reach the next tier. It was hard to have a clear overview of the missions needed to unlock specific elements.
[/p]
[p]
Now, an [b]experience[/b] and [b]chef hats[/b] system has been introduced. Missions are still present but now give more experience and money. You also gain experience simply by playing normally.
[/p]
[p][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279628/5de78f7e27b12039544914b3f8fedbed5a5fe039.png[/img][/p]
[p]
As you progress, you earn [b]chef hats[/b] visible on the new HUD. With these hats and money, you can unlock different game elements via a new PC app: [b]Extension[/b].
[/p]
[p]
Elements are now displayed as a [b]dependency tree[/b]. You can choose to focus first on employees, dishes, or decorations depending on your play style.
[/p]
[p]
Moving from one tier to the next no longer requires completing the previous tier entirely. You just pay a number of hats and money proportional to the number of remaining locked items. This allows some players to progress quickly without unlocking all current tier items.
[/p]
[p][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279628/3bac95478eca47535eb02c6d4138eb970d09e08b.png[/img][/p]
[p]
For old saves, don’t worry: everything has been migrated automatically. All your unlocked items are kept in this new system. Tier 3 is currently locked and will be unlocked in the next major update including the rooftop. Start collecting hats now to use them when it’s released.
[/p]

[h2]🧑‍🍳 New Employee Task System[/h2]
[p]
You can now precisely configure your employees’ tasks from the PC.
[/p]
[p][b]Servers:[/b][/p]
[list]
[*][p]Take orders[/p]
[*][p]Serve dishes[/p]
[*][p]Clean tables[/p]
[/list]
[p][b]Bartenders:[/b][/p]
[list]
[*][p]Serve drinks[/p]
[*][p]Collect payments[/p]
[/list]
[p]
This system allows you to assign certain tasks to your employees and handle others yourself, or optimize efficiency by specializing each employee in a specific task. When the restaurant is full, task distribution prevents efficiency loss from workload overload.
[/p]
[p][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279628/8c094d726cd76135351d6702f34e19d713c5782e.png[/img][/p]

[h2]🎰 Casino Opening[/h2]
[p]
The casino is now open. It currently has two themed slot machines:
[/p]
[list]
[*][p]China[/p]
[*][p]Egypt[/p]
[/list]
[p]
Each machine works with a [b]25-payline[/b] system. By default, 20 lines are active, but you can adjust this with the + and - buttons. Total bet is divided by the number of active lines. Reducing lines decreases chances to win but increases potential payout per line. Increasing lines increases chances to win but reduces payout per line.
[/p]
[p]
Each machine also has a very rare [b]jackpot[/b]. The jackpot starts at [b]€20,000[/b] per machine and is saved. It gradually increases as players use the machine. It is very rare to hit, but if luck smiles on you, you can win huge sums.
[/p]
[p][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279628/e960e37fedc9da6ab35aa3e76557fe514f312040.png[/img][/p]

[h2]💡 Quality of Life Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*][p]You can now order kitchen tables and place them freely in the kitchen or bakery. Default tables have been removed.[/p]
[p][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279628/0fcce0c004742082b7a6ba29889494eaea48dfd1.png[/img][/p]
[*][p]Bakery trays can now be stacked to optimize space.[/p]
[p][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279628/12c1492c87e2b3e47f19b41681ecc4855317b341.png[/img][/p]
[*][p]An option now allows disabling the bell sound when a dish is ready.[/p]
[*][p]The view when moving the bakery cart has been improved with partial occlusion to prevent obstruction.[/p]
[*][p]The brasserie can be renamed from the computer.[/p]
[/list]

[h2]🛠️ Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*][p]Fixed a bug preventing customers’ heads from rotating correctly when chatting at the table.[/p]
[*][p]Fixed a bug preventing guests from collecting boxes from carts.[/p]
[/list]

This update, version 0.6.0, is primarily focused on [b]optimization[/b]. We apologize for the delay; this optimization took longer than expected as it involved a complete overhaul both on the CPU and graphical side. Work has been ongoing since mid-December, and we hope it will satisfy you.  

These improvements were necessary to prepare for what’s coming next: the [b]rooftop, new floors, new employees, and new clients[/b]. Without this update, performance would have suffered significantly when the restaurant is fully populated, causing FPS drops depending on your configuration.

We also take this opportunity to wish our Chinese players a very happy [b]Year of the Horse[/b]! 🐎

[/p][h2]⚡ Main Change – Optimization[/h2][p][/p][p] The main focus of this update is performance optimization, targeting two axes: [/p][list][*][p][b]NPC Optimization:[/b] The multiplication of customers and employees in the restaurant previously caused performance drops. Each NPC added processing overhead, and with hundreds of them, FPS could drop significantly. For example, on my configuration, FPS went from ~90–100 to ~60 in a full restaurant.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Graphical Optimization:[/b] Dynamic lighting and shadows have been reworked to improve performance without compromising visuals. You will notice smoother lighting and better performance across Low, Medium, and High settings.
[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279628/2b00ab31beabc4a7e5ab4c20c588aa65cbf8abec.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Important:[/b] Parisian Brasserie Simulator is designed to run with a [b]dedicated GPU[/b]. Laptops or PCs with integrated GPUs will not achieve optimal performance despite these improvements.   With a dedicated GPU (GTX 970, 1080, RTX 3070, etc.), you can now enjoy much better FPS.   [/p][list][*][p]For maximum FPS, enable [b]Nvidia DLSS[/b] if you have a compatible Nvidia card.  
[/p][/*][*][p]On supported Nvidia 4000 series GPUs, you can enable [b]Frame Generation[/b] for an additional FPS boost.  
[/p][/*][*][p]Both AMD/Nvidia users can use [b]FSR[/b], which provides a similar improvement.  
[/p][/*][*][p]With Frame Generation enabled, I now reach 200 FPS on high settings with a full restaurant.
[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h2]💡 Quality of Life Improvements[/h2][p][/p][p][b]Visual Improvements: [/b]This optimization brings not only FPS gains but also a noticeable visual improvement. Shadows and lighting in Low and Medium settings are now much closer to High settings. A new Eiffel Tower has been added. Night scenes now feature a well-lit city, moon, stars, and a restaurant with comfortable lighting for your eyes. Minor graphical glitches on NPCs’ clothing and skin have been fixed. Low settings now allow both smooth FPS and attractive visuals.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279628/e07515a8ac37088c083188bc7a3ad651154264c4.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279628/2ebc376cb3c75b550ee8d42abfc8cee332c3fe46.png"][/img]

[/p][p][b]Delivery System:[/b] Many of you reported delivery taking too long or trucks getting lost in Paris. In this update, delivery has been reworked:[/p][p]Delivery time is no longer affected by delivery cost; it now depends on the number of delivery employees.   [/p][list][*][p]The truck will arrive behind the restaurant in a dedicated alley, avoiding blocking roads.  
[/p][/*][*][p]Delivery employees now run faster and unload trucks more efficiently.  
[/p][/*][*][p]Reminder: Placing trolleys (diables) outside the restaurant will allow employees to pick them up, greatly improving unloading speed.
[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279628/00a9b779fe2c4f9e29ac5340aee43a37cf4d3f09.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Bakery Automation:[/b] Many of you shared your opinions—some were tired of making breakfasts, others loved it, and some wanted a break. A good compromise has been found: from the Menu app, you can now enable an option to automate the bakery, which is activated by default. When enabled, if breakfast stock runs out, employees will order the breakfast via the tablet, and your cook will prepare it as a regular dish. Employees will always prioritize freshly prepared breakfasts, and only use the tablet orders if none are available.[/p][p]

Many of our playtesters play the game on Steam Deck with touch controls. It also plays great on touch devices through Steam Link, so you can play on your phone or tablet!

We are still working on Steam Deck verification, thanks for your patience.

[b]Is there controller support?
[/b]Not yet! We love playing deckbuilders with controllers, so this is on the roadmap. However, with so many menus we wanted to make sure we took the time to make it the smoothest and best experience possible. We will keep you updated on this!

[b]Is the game appropriate for all ages?[/b][/p][p]Depends, but we have had playtesters as young as six playing the game (with some reading assistance from an adult!)
